title: Bourbon Bread Pudding
description: Cinnamon-vanilla bread pudding with a golden top and warm brown-butter and brown sugar bourbon sauce.
imageAlt: Golden bread pudding with bourbon sauce on a navy plate

items: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter, for the pan
10 ounces day-old French bread, cut in 1-inch cubes (about 8 cups)
¾ cup packed light brown sugar
½ cup packed light brown sugar

steps.title: Prepare the bread
steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 9-inch square baking dish with 1 tablespoon butter and spread 10 ounces of bread cubes in it.

steps.title: Soak the bread
steps.text: Whisk 4 eggs, 2 cups milk, 1 cup cream, ¾ cup packed brown sugar, 2 teaspoons vanilla, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, ¼ teaspoon nutmeg, and ½ teaspoon salt until smooth. Pour the custard over the bread and gently press down any dry pieces. Soak for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Bake until set
steps.text: Bake for 40–50 minutes, until the top is golden and the center is set and registers at least 160°F. Let the pudding rest for 10 minutes before cutting.

steps.title: Brown the sauce butter
steps.text: While the pudding rests, melt the 4 tablespoons sauce butter in a small light-colored saucepan over medium-low heat. Stir across the bottom until the foam reveals hazelnut-brown flecks and a toasted aroma. Immediately pour it all into a heatproof bowl.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: With the pan off the heat, add ½ cup cream, ½ cup packed brown sugar, a pinch of salt, and the browned butter, scraping in the toasted flecks. Return to medium-low heat and whisk at a gentle simmer for 3–4 minutes until smooth. Move the pan away from the burner before stirring in 2 tablespoons bourbon.

steps.title: Serve warm
steps.text: Cut the pudding into squares and spoon the warm bourbon sauce over each serving. The sauce contains alcohol.
